policy.promotion: existing end-to-end holdout + walk-forward + live evidence gates remain mandatory

historical_reference.source: frozen 2026 baseball bootstrap; FINAL-only; not betting-profitability evidence

methodology.alternate_runlines: event-level alternate_spreads; evaluates both +/-1.5 pairs when actually available
methodology.calibration: hierarchical market fallback + phase-specific challenger; identity vs Platt vs beta; holdout Brier/LogLoss/ECE; existing stack walk-forward remains mandatory
methodology.canonical_research_boundary: featured standard sharp RL/TOTAL may train calibration when Winamax is absent; alternate_spreads are excluded
methodology.distribution: correlated NB mixture; validated historical FINAL fallback; dynamic tail truncation
methodology.event_matching: team identity + closest commence_time within strict tolerance
methodology.execution: fixed Winamax canonical lines for evaluation; all executable lines for selection
methodology.execution_freshness: Winamax is optional execution/display only; if shown, timestamp required and max age 15 min
methodology.historical_evidence: legacy V10 1,801-game data are diagnostic only until a V12.3 structural baseline exists
methodology.runs_model: immutable structural baseline + validated FINAL historical prior fallback + phase-specific live residual
methodology.selection: informational recommendations use model confidence + conservative EV/edge + DQ + uncertainty + Kelly; Winamax never decides eligibility
methodology.selection_reference_price: fresh configured sharp books; exact side/point; second-best effective quote when >=2 books, otherwise single fresh sharp quote
methodology.sharp_disagreement: large model-vs-sharp disagreement reduces selection score but is not a hard directional veto
methodology.staking: bankroll-aware fractional Kelly; official combos disabled
methodology.starter_model: current season + N-1/N-2 prior affects structural run means
methodology.uncertainty: empirical phase/market reliability bins + market disagreement + DQ penalty
methodology.v115_shadow: frozen V11.5 probability challenger runs on the same game/market snapshot; research-only and never changes V12 selection
methodology.v124_predictive_shadow: 8-module predictive challenger with ablation variants; research-only; V12.3.2 remains official Champion
methodology.v124_research_monitor: one latest settled pre-game snapshot per gamePk; per-market ablations, optimizer progress, disagreements and prior-run deltas; Discord monitor is non-blocking

1_platoon_handedness.note: player-level lineup splits vs opposing starter hand; sample shrinkage; fail-neutral

3_bullpen_player_level.note: reliever ERA/WHIP quality, 3-day pitch load, consecutive usage and availability

4_lineup_player_level.note: non-linear player value with batting-order exposure instead of a single average only

5_starter_expected_ip.note: expected starter innings from season workload/starts and skill; rebalances starter/team pitching mix

6_weather_park_interaction.note: air density + field-relative wind + MLB venue azimuth fallback + roof-state safety; no fabricated field bearing

7_uncertainty_decomposition.note: starter + lineup + bullpen + Statcast + sharp dispersion + V11/V12 disagreement

8_model_ensemble.note: V12.4 core + V12 + V11.5 + sharp; uncertainty shrink; never selects official bets
